AutocompleteCategory.description: A catalogue item that lets the user select one or more criteria from a predefined list. The list of criteria is not rendered. Instead the user can find and select items by typing into an autocomplete text box. The resulting query matches any of the selected criteria.

criteria.description: The list of criteria the user can select from

infoButtonText.description: Optional text that is accessed by clicking a "ⓘ" button next to the display name

key.description: A key that uniquely identifies the catalogue item. It is typically used to look up the CQL snippet for that item.

CatalogueInput.description: The catalogue as passed to `setCatalogue`, before references are resolved. Unlike a plain Catalogue it may contain RefCategory nodes, which are replaced at runtime by categories loaded from external files. The JSON schema is generated from this type so that catalogue files may contain references.

CatalogueInputCategory.description: A catalogue item that may appear in a CatalogueInput, including references.

CatalogueInputGroup.description: A category group whose children may themselves contain references.

childCategories.description: The list of catalogue items in the group, possibly including references

infoButtonText.description: Optional text that is accessed by clicking a "ⓘ" button next to the display name

infoLink.description: Optional hyperlink shown next to the display name

Criteria.description: A criterion that can be selected in a single-select or autocomplete catalogue item.

description.description: Optional description that is shown next to the display name during autocompletion

key.description: A key that uniquely identifies the criterion

DateRangeCategory.description: A catalogue item that lets the user specify a date range by picking an earliest and a latest date. The user can omit one of the dates to express earlier than or later than constraints.

key.description: A key that uniquely identifies the catalogue item. It is typically used to look up the CQL snippet for that item.

max.description: The latest date that the user can pick

min.description: The earliest date that the user can pick

NumericRangeCategory.description: A catalogue item that lets the user specify a numeric range by entering a minimum and a maximum value. The user can omit one of the values to express less than or greater than constraints.

infoButtonText.description: Optional text that is accessed by clicking a "ⓘ" button next to the display name

key.description: A key that uniquely identifies the catalogue item. It is typically used to look up the CQL snippet for that item.

max.description: The largest value that the user can enter

min.description: The smallest value that the user can enter

unitText.description: Optional text that is shown next to the input field, e.g. "kg"

RefCategory.description: A placeholder that is replaced at runtime by categories loaded from an external JSON file. The file must contain an array of categories that is spliced into the catalogue in place of this node. This lets multiple projects share a single source of truth for large code lists such as ICD-10. If the file is unreachable or invalid the node is dropped and a warning is logged to the browser console.

url.description: URL of a JSON file containing an array of categories that replaces this node

SingleSelectCategory.description: A catalogue item that lets the user select one or more criteria from a predefined list. The list of criteria is rendered in the catalogue tree and the user can select criteria by clicking a "->" button. The resulting query matches any of the selected criteria.

criteria.description: The list of criteria the user can select from

infoButtonText.description: Optional text that is accessed by clicking a "ⓘ" button next to the display name

key.description: A key that uniquely identifies the catalogue item. It is typically used to look up the CQL snippet for that item.

subCategoryName.description: This overwrites the display name in the catalogue component only. The intended use-case is to have multiple catalogue items with the same key and name but different subCategoryName. They will appear as different collapsable entries in the catalogue but will be grouped together in the same chip in the search bar.

StringCategory.description: A catalogue item that lets the user to specify a string.

infoButtonText.description: Optional text that is accessed by clicking a "ⓘ" button next to the display name

key.description: A key that uniquely identifies the catalogue item. It is typically used to look up the CQL snippet for that item.
